result.title: Can Hindsight Critics Guide Delayed Actors?
result.comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Accepted for publication at the AJCAI2026 conference. Cite as: "López, F. M., & Cruz, F. (2026). Can Hindsight Critics Guide Delayed Actors?. In Australasian Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (pp. 1-10). Cham: Springer International Publishing."
result.summary: Sensory delays create temporal misalignments between the state of the environment and the observations available to an agent, turning Markovian control problems into partially observable ones. In this work, we inquire whether such misalignments can be mitigated during training by using hindsight to recover aligned state-action transitions. We introduce Hindsight Critics, an asymmetric extension of the Soft Actor-Critic for reinforcement learning under partial observability. The critics are trained on hindsight-aligned transitions whereas the actor learns from the resulting privileged value estimates despite only having access to delayed observations. Comparisons against delay-aware and unaware baselines on the DelayBench suite show that Hindsight Critics can partially compensate for observation delays without requiring modifications to the agent's observations during deployment.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究感官延迟导致的状态—观测时间错位问题，提出 Hindsight Critics：在非对称 Soft Actor-Critic 中，用后见信息对齐的 state-action transition 训练 critic，使只能获得延迟观测的 actor 借助特权价值估计学习，并在 DelayBench 上与延迟感知/无感知基线比较。
AI.relevance_reason: 延迟观测与非对称特权 critic 的训练思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中「训练期用完整视觉证据、推理期仅有受限观测」的监督与信用分配问题，但其为连续控制 RL 设定，向 VLM latent 推理的迁移尚属推测。
